title: Surviving MCP actions still misreport completion, require checkout access for reads, and return unbounded detail
wanted_capability: A reviewed per-action MCP contract: unknown task IDs cannot produce all_completed=true; project-filtered pin reads must use catalog filtering; typed filters must reject invalid values; returned detail must be bounded and recoverable; search hints must match the hit entity type; retired no-op actions need a deliberate discovery disposition.
notes: Live audit: unknown-only bro_when_all returns all_completed=true with zero results while bro_wait rejects the same ID. Pin list with a registered project fails attachment_inactive; no project filter succeeds. Invalid brofile/MCP list scope returns normal results, invalid pin scope and packet event operation return empty success. Search of this audit thread recommends bbox_messages with an empty session ID. Graph describe returns 26237 result bytes, thread get 23108, unmatched knowledge recall 6789. Record precise dispositions in the action audit. This gap tracks caller-facing corrections; checkout transaction/replay redesign and edge-index scheduling remain separate existing gaps.
